units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 9:2">Keth. IX, 2</cite> <he>והיה לו פקדון או מ׳ וכ׳</he> and left a trust or a loan in the hands of strangers.
<cite ref="Ketubot 84a:14">Ib. 84ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ להוצאה ניתנה</he> a loan is made to be spent (opp. to trust).

<cite ref="Kiddushin 6b:8">Kidd. 6ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>המקדש במ׳ וכ׳</he> if one betroths a woman to himself by remitting her indebtedness to him, she is not betrothed (there being no consideration offered to her at the time); <he>בהנאת מ׳</he> offering as a consideration the benefit of the loan (by extension). Ib. 47ᵇ, a. fr. <he>מ׳ על פה</he> a verbal loan, <he>מ׳ בשטר</he> against a note. Ib. 46ᵃ, a. e. <he>המקדש במ׳ ופרוטה</he> if one betroths a woman with remittance of a loan and the offer of a P’rutah besides.—
<cite ref="Bekhorot 48a:8">Bekh. 48ᵃ</cite>; a. e. <he>מ׳ הכתובה בתורה</he> an obligation arising from a Biblical law, e.g. the duty of redeeming the first-born; a. fr.
